source_strategy.registry: ClinicalTrials.gov official history API; exact selected versions on or before cutoff; result modules are projected deterministically from the canonical historical record.
source_strategy.publication: PubMed/PMC and peer-reviewed primary reports; PubMed sources were re-fetched through NCBI E-utilities where page routes challenged.
source_strategy.regulatory: FDA/EMA/NMPA and company regulatory pages re-fetched; effective/first-disclosure dates remain distinct from acquisition time.
source_strategy.company_and_transaction: Company official disclosures, SEC/HKEX filings; SEC exhibits re-fetched directly with a compliant User-Agent and gzip decoding.
source_strategy.patent: Google Patents primary publication records re-fetched; legal-status caveat and no legal conclusion retained.
source_strategy.chinese_industry: Chinese-language sources retained only where an actual source capture exists; no inferred values.

clinicaltrials_history_api.canonicalization: recursive HTML entity unescape for parser comparison only; source content stores canonical JSON and raw HTTP envelope is archived separately.

wiley_scope.key_conclusion_supported: DOI identity, primary abstract, 39.1-point EASI-75 delta, exact safety rates
wiley_scope.reason: Crossref abstract does not expose the arm-level EASI-75 and URI values; those claims are excluded from the refreshed A-key claim set.

nejm_scope.required_domain: Exact SOLO 1 any-AE pair retained because marketed-product completeness requires numeric any-TEAE treatment/control rows; no proxy or inferred replacement used.

observations: R03 来源包完整性复核通过：38 个产品、49 项试验；产品—试验—疗效—安全性关系闭合，空结果与零结果误判未发生。
8 条出现历史投影诊断的 ClinicalTrials.gov 记录均已用截止日前官方 history API 版本重读；7 条原投影问题已闭合，NCT05509023 已补投影 7 条疗效、25 条数值安全性和 4 条未公开安全性维度。
ClinicalTrials.gov NCT05608343 已补投影 4 条疗效与 8 条安全性；所有新增行均绑定精确历史 field_path、arm identity 与原始历史版本 URL。
44 条非登记决定性来源均已在 R03 重新抓取或通过明确替代官方/元数据路线复核；Wiley 主文与 NEJM 主文直连限制及其对具体 claim 的边界已写入审计，未把阻断页当作证据。
所有来源 first_disclosed_at 不晚于 2026-07-31；获取时间单独保存，未以获取时间替代首次披露时间。
本记录仅是 R03 包级来源与结构完整性复核，不替代 Codex 的最终临床、中文、浏览器和视觉验收。

no_draft_on_block: If Codex identifies key-evidence insufficiency, cutoff disagreement, or browser/clinical acceptance failure, do not copy this package into a final project or render a draft; retain the audit and explicit missingness.
